stem.text: Two bar magnets P and Q are mounted on floats which can slide without friction along an air track.

stem.alt: Two bar magnets on floats on an air track. Magnet P is labelled S on the left and N on the right, with an arrow above it pointing right. Magnet Q is labelled N on the left and S on the right, with an arrow above it pointing left. The air track and floats are labelled.

stem.text: The two magnets slide towards each other along the air track and interact, without making contact.
The relative speed of approach of the magnets is equal to their relative speed of separation.
Which statement about P and Q must be correct?

A.text: During the interaction between P and Q some of the total kinetic energy is lost.

B.text: During the interaction between P and Q some of the total momentum is lost.

C.text: The momentum of Q after the interaction is equal to the momentum of P before the interaction.

D.text: The values of (kinetic energy of P + kinetic energy of Q) before and after the interaction are equal.
